sources: catalog/production/thomas-supplement-r1/brief-2026-11-19 (托马斯动作库补充-制作说明 item 1)

purpose.zh: 练肩胛骨下面那块肌肉，单手撑地时肩不塌
purpose.en: Trains the muscle under your shoulder blades so your shoulder stays solid on one hand.

text.zh: 手肘一直锁直，只让肩胛骨动
text.en: Elbows stay locked, only your shoulder blades move

text.zh: 胸口往地面沉一点，再用手把地面推开、上背拱起来。
text.en: Let your chest sink a little, then push the floor away and round your upper back.

text.zh: 推到最高停一下，感觉腋下那块在用力。
text.en: Pause at the top and feel the side of your ribs working.

commonErrors.zh: 手肘弯了，变成普通俯卧撑
commonErrors.en: Bending your elbows and turning it into a regular push-up.
Shrugging and pushing your head forward.

cautions.zh: 推起来肩前侧疼就先跪着做
cautions.en: If the front of your shoulder hurts, do it on your knees.

thomasSupplement.thomasAngle: 10 第一侧移重 / 14 第二侧移重
thomasSupplement.camera: 正侧面（看肩胛下沉与推开）＋斜后上方（看背部拱起）
thomasSupplement.doseBrief: 3 组 × 10–12 次，休 60 秒；顶端停 1 秒
thomasSupplement.note: defaultDose takes the low end of the brief range; the range is in doseBrief.
